Documentation and source code consistency audit ​

Executed on 2026-10-08 per the "Documentation and source code consistency audit specification": all documentation surfaces checked against source code as the source of truth, with the three difference categories (① document ahead of code / ② code ahead of document / ③ description mismatch) each backed by file:line evidence. Fixes only modify documents, never code (reverse code changes forbidden). Newly added features must be written back to the corresponding rows of this document.

1. Audit scope and method ​

14 documentation surfaces in total: README.md, docs/{index,mission,mission-excerpt,mvp-issues,positioning,solution-structure,troubleshooting,configuration,master-plan,acceptance-checklist}.md, docs/acceptance-{B705-L0-behavior,B803-e2e-walkthrough}.md, docs/rfc/RFC-001-technical-design.md, plus the mkdocs.yml navigation. (From the 2026-10-11 incremental review onward, configuration.md, master-plan.md, and acceptance-checklist.md were brought into scope; at the F-01~34 baseline audit they did not yet exist or were not included.)

Method: sample verifiable technical claims and gather evidence against the code one by one (widget type strings, interface signatures, configuration keys, file names, package references, window forms, refresh periods); a null grep result first requires verifying the path exists (e.g. ls src/) before concluding "does not exist". mission-excerpt.md (original plan archive) and the two acceptance documents (dated acceptance records) are treated as historical literature; only the code references that are still alive are checked.

3. Conclusions and P0 list ​

  • ① Document ahead of code: 6 items (F-03~08); ② Code ahead of document: 4 items (F-09~12); ③ Description mismatch: 24 items (F-01/02, F-13~34). Total 34 items.
  • Claims verified as consistent, no changes needed: all of README (download form/install path/hotkey/autostart default/1809+/codecov/nightly early-morning release), all of troubleshooting (log file names/crash logs/install path), solution-structure §3.6 test description (coverlet+Codecov accurate), RFC §9.2 secret constraints and §8 default rule existence, code references in both acceptance documents.
  • P0 list (2 items):
    • F-01: RFC widgets.json example key repository ≠ actual repo — writing a widget per the document will definitely fail;
    • F-02: RFC pins.json flat example ≠ actual {widgetId, layout{...}} nesting + camelCase enums — reading/writing pins.json per the document will definitely be wrong.
  • Fix principle: treat source code as truth and only change documents; "document ahead" items are marked "not implemented/planned" rather than deleting design intent; no items requiring reverse code changes were found this time.
  • 2026-10-10 re-review: all 34 fixes have been written back to the corresponding documents (spot-checked one by one against code; F-03 was recorded directly per implementation because notifications.json landed on 2026-10-09, exceeding the original "mark as not implemented" fix; F-07 closed the same day). The 34 F-numbers in the table above are now aligned with the counts in this conclusion (previously the conclusion under-counted F-32~34; index.md "30 items" corrected together).
